    <title>v2.13.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>api:</strong> add an error code to Message Batches creation</li>
<li><strong>api:</strong> add External Storage to the Admin API beta</li>
<li><strong>api:</strong> add webhook events for external storage failure and recovery</li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>client:</strong> build the right class for tool results with unknown values</li>
</ul>
<h3>Chores</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>api:</strong> mark Claude Opus 4.5 as deprecated (end-of-life January 22, 2027)</li>
<li><strong>client:</strong> read deprecated models from generated data and stop warning on retired ones</li>
<li><strong>docs:</strong> clarify when plugin archive downloads are recorded and who gave a share</li>
<li><strong>docs:</strong> correct organization-type notes in usage and cost reports</li>
<li><strong>docs:</strong> describe the user profile endpoints and link to the guide</li>
<li><strong>docs:</strong> use realistic example values in more request bodies</li>
</ul>
<h3>Documentation</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>api:</strong> shorten the human_review description</li>
</ul></content>
